answer: At dawn, every agent must open its relay terrace: each identity carries a slice of the network message traffic across a bridge of signed receipts, and its voting weight scales with the volume it provably relayed during the epoch. A Sybil operator spinning up a thousand fake identities must also buy a thousand slices of bandwidth, because receipts are checked against senders' logs and fabricated traffic is dropped. Honest agents pay almost nothing extra, since relaying is work they already do, while the attacker pays a linear, unforgeable network bill for every extra face.
